correctness.rationale: For each edge, convexity makes a farthest polygon point a vertex; the other two vertex distances are dominated. The squared maximal distance is max of two explicitly given quadratics F and G. F decreases, G increases beyond their crossing, and the crossing lies in the edge exactly for 1≤r≤3. This proves the complete center locus and piecewise exact radius. Differentiating explicit scale-free formulas proves both sharp area and perimeter inequalities with all equality cases. Exact rational checker.py tests 10,410 comparisons as corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural similarity-class classification of the polygonal self-Chebyshev invariant within rhombi, including an exact geometric change from four interior-edge boundary centers to two obtuse vertices at 60°. The strongest contribution is the sharp area-normalized inequality δ²/A≥2/√3 with a non-square unique optimizer, contrasting with the square uniquely extremizing the perimeter-normalized ratio. Both results have explicit equality cases and complement the published magic-kite global quadrilateral comparison without assuming a larger theorem.
